title: EntityPropertyCollectionDescriptor
description: Turns a scalar entity property into an ordered primitive collection (a list of values of the property type).
markdownDescription: AI guidance: add `collection` to store a list of values such as tags, scores, enum flags, or multiple files/images. The element type is the property `type`; supported element types are string, int, long, decimal, money, datetime, date, time, boolean, guid, enum, file, and image. Collections are stored in normalized collection tables, so `isMappedToDbField` does not apply. `uniqueItems` must be decided explicitly. A collection cannot be combined with `foreignKey`, `formula`, or `rollup`.

maxCount.description: Maximum number of items allowed. Omit or null for no limit.

uniqueItems.description: Whether duplicate values are rejected. Required; choose true for tag-like lists and false for repeatable values.
